answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Macaroon credential with attenuating caveats stops them at the door: a credential that narrows with every delegation, which means the willow of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the plume is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ridge for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
